Fulfillment & Delivery Standards

Shipping & Service Delivery Policy

Guidelines for In-Clinic Services, Digital Masterclasses & Herbal Shipments

At Charak Health Solutions (Dr. Surabhi Vaidya Clinic), our primary offerings consist of specialized healthcare consultations, in-person clinical therapies, and live online educational masterclasses. This policy explains how each service and physical product is delivered to patients.

Clear Indication of Business Category & Nature of Services

Charak Health Solutions operates in the Healthcare & Clinical Medical Services category. We provide medical consultations, non-surgical Panchakarma joint preservation treatments, and patient education.

1. Delivery of In-Clinic Medical Consultations

For patients booking an In-Clinic Diagnostic Consultation (₹1,000) or 1-Day Trial (₹4,000):

  • Delivery Mode: In-person clinical consultation at our clinic: Cura 304, Raymond TenX Habitat, Pokharan Road No. 2, Vartak Nagar, Thane West, Maharashtra 400606.
  • Confirmation Timeline: Instant booking confirmation is generated on-screen immediately upon submission, with appointment slot details and Google Maps directions dispatched via WhatsApp and SMS within 5 minutes.
  • Service Fulfillment: Delivered on the scheduled appointment date and time. Dr. Surabhi Vaidya conducts a comprehensive 30-minute pulse diagnosis (Naadi Parikshan) and joint mobility evaluation.

2. Delivery of Online Masterclasses & Digital Educational Services

For attendees registering for the Live Knee & Spine Pain Relief Masterclass (₹201):

  • Delivery Mode: Digital electronic broadcast room link delivered via WhatsApp, SMS, and Email.
  • Confirmation Timeline: Immediately upon successful payment via PayU / Cashfree, attendees are automatically redirected to their dedicated Live Masterclass Room (/room) and receive their calendar invitation pass.
  • Reminders: Automated reminder alerts containing the direct joining link are dispatched 24 hours and 1 hour before the live session starts.

3. Physical Shipping of Prescribed Ayurvedic Formulations (If Applicable)

In cases where customized classical Ayurvedic herbal formulations, medicated oils, or joint health supplements are prescribed and dispatched to the patient's residence:

  • Dispatch Timeline: Prescribed formulations are packed and dispatched within 24 to 48 business hours following the clinical consultation.
  • Delivery Duration: Standard courier delivery typically takes 3 to 7 business days across India depending on the recipient’s PIN code.
  • Courier Partners: Shipped via reliable Indian courier partners (India Post Speed Post, Blue Dart, Delhivery, or DTDC).
  • Tracking: Shipment tracking numbers are sent directly to the patient's registered WhatsApp mobile number once the parcel is handed to the courier.
  • Shipping Charges: Any applicable delivery or courier charges are clearly communicated in advance during the consultation or order invoice.

4. Damaged or Non-Receipt of Physical Formulations

If your shipment arrives damaged, unsealed, or has not reached you within 7 business days of dispatch, please contact our clinic desk immediately at kneeandbackpainclinic@gmail.com with your order details and photos of the package. We will arrange a prompt replacement or resolution within 24 business hours.
